kernel_build: build.rs compiles the 13 SYCL translation units concurrently (was a sequential loop); full kernels-crate rebuild ~2.5 min wall on 64 cores
conclusion: The B70 decode mat-vec was not kernel-bound: two-pass geometry is at the practical roofline (lm_head 551 GB/s effective on 504 MB; 686 GB/s peak measured on q4_0 4096x4096), so the kept optimization is host-side (persistent scratch). Sub-group fusion is a real win only where launches dominate; on this device it is not. Next lever, if decode latency matters, is per-layer launch batching, not kernel geometry.
